'''Sabacc game mode music''' collects music planned for the [[True Sabacc]] game mode on this wiki's [[GEMP]] table. It starts with one demo song for '''Cloud City Sabacc''', the planned Cloud City casino setting.

''Status: planning stub. Nothing here is final. Sections below are placeholders to fill in.''

== Cloud City casino song ==

'''Concept.''' A song for the Cloud City Sabacc setting, played inside the Cloud City casino (see [[Sabacc game mode outline]]).

'''Original demo.''' [[Bill Bisco]] recorded a 57-second voice demo of the song idea. It is a rough demo, not a finished track. Bill is the composer and author of the original demo.

'''Plan.''' Refine and improve the song with an AI music tool that can start from an uploaded demo. No tool has been chosen. The original demo is kept unchanged; any refined version is recorded in the log below.

'''Audio on this wiki.''' This wiki does not currently accept audio uploads, so the demo is not embedded here.
